categories.title: Assessment & Evidence
categories.description: Tools that analyze student evidence, organize feedback, and generate instructional follow-up.

categories.title: Create Classroom Resources
categories.description: Build ready-to-use classroom resources from learning targets, teacher constraints, and optional source materials.

categories.title: Planning & Extension
categories.description: Tools that turn teacher learning targets and constraints into ready-to-use instructional resources.

tools.title: Grading & Evidence Control Panel
tools.summary: Package student evidence, an optional rubric, roster, and teacher notes into one self-contained request ZIP for analysis, reports, practice, and stations.

tools.title: Tiered Task Tool
tools.summary: Build one research-informed DOK 1-4 extension task card from 1-4 I Can statements, teacher constraints, optional resources, and selected student product choices.

tools.title: District Resource Builder
tools.summary: Choose a resource type, add learning targets and constraints, attach optional sources, and build a self-contained request ZIP for a finished classroom resource with teacher materials and QA.

tools.title: Math Worksheet Builder
tools.summary: Create original math worksheet requests from course/topic-filtered generator families, including Lower Elementary, Grade 4, Grade 5, and Grade 7 ratios, with parallel forms, two-column print, and per-problem workspace/visual controls.
